title: Great Mosque of Aleppo
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Great Mosque of Aleppo exterior from four inspected2009 pictures:banded square stone minaret/open timber crown and shallow pyramidal cap,rectangular court with three pointed arcades,tall closed timber prayer-facade fields/raised dark-patterned portal,grey prayer roof dome,two independent domed column pavilions and broad original court paving bands. Five existing shared256² graphs,at most seven merged groups,four authored budgeted browser levels. Current six-point outer/four-point court controls retain exact plan;all untagged heights and landmark component plans are explicit picture estimates. Historical exterior approximation;current restoration state,unseen roofs/interiors and precise terrain contacts unverified.
